documents.text: For a late pickup at Northgate, enter locker code LANTERN-42.
Northgate accepts returns within 18 days of delivery.
Use invoice reference INV-804 to request a copy of the invoice.
For repairs, book a technician at the Cedar desk.
Visitors should park at the east entrance and use the green lift.
Track a shipment using the parcel link in the dispatch email.
